::: {#def-mean-squares}
#### Mean squares

In one-way analysis of variance,
the **mean squares** are the sums of squares divided by their degrees of freedom:
$\text{MS}_\text{between} \eqdef \text{SS}_\text{between} / (k - 1)$
and $\text{MS}_\text{within} \eqdef \text{SS}_\text{within} / (n - k)$.
:::
